description: This file contains extension methods for Roslyn compiler symbols, providing utilities for type and symbol analysis, attribute retrieval, and name formatting within the Orleans code generation project.

classes.name: SymbolExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for Roslyn symbol analysis, type name formatting, attribute retrieval, and hierarchy inspection.

methods.name: HasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a symbol has a specific attribute, considering inheritance if specified.

methods.name: GetAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute data from a symbol, considering inheritance if specified.

methods.name: ToTypeSyntax
methods.description: Converts a type symbol to a Roslyn TypeSyntax, with optional substitutions for type parameters.

methods.name: ToDisplayName
methods.description: Generates a string representation of a type or assembly symbol, with options for including namespace and global specifier.

methods.name: ToTypeSyntaxInner
methods.description: Internal method to build a TypeSyntax from a type symbol, considering namespace and nested types.

methods.name: ToNameSyntax
methods.description: Converts a type symbol to a Roslyn NameSyntax.

methods.name: GetValidIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a valid C# identifier string from a type symbol.

methods.name: HasBaseType
methods.description: Checks if a type symbol has a specific base type.

methods.name: HasAnyAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a symbol has any attribute from a list of attribute types.

methods.name: GetAnyAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves any attribute data from a symbol that matches a list of attribute types.

methods.name: GetAllMembers
methods.description: Retrieves all members of a specific name and optional accessibility from a type, including inherited members.

methods.name: GetDeclaredInstanceMembers
methods.description: Retrieves all non-static members of a type.

methods.name: GetNamespaceAndNesting
methods.description: Builds a string representing the namespace and nesting hierarchy of a symbol.

methods.name: GetAllTypeParameters
methods.description: Retrieves all type parameters of a generic type, including those from containing types.

methods.name: GetAllTypeArguments
methods.description: Retrieves all type arguments of a generic type, including those from containing types.

methods.name: IsAssignableFrom
methods.description: Checks if a type is assignable from another type, considering interface and class hierarchies.

methods.name: GetDeclaredTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all declared types within an assembly.
